Great service despite the language barrier at the front desk. Quality and affordable dental work (scaling and polishing). Very quick and efficient check in process. Was ushered into the treatment room almost immediately after checking in. The team and the doc were awaiting me prepared and ready to help me. The Dentist simply asked me, in understandable English,what I needed, I told him, and he did it.

Highly rcommended. I will return again for other procedures as needed.

Good dentist here. Dr. Padej has expertise in Maxillofacial—teeth structures that relate to the face. He is also very kind and nice and fair for his cure such as the remedy of teeth roots. If the first step of cure is not succeed, he can claim our expense to another cure. I am very impressed with is clinic by his expertise, remedy cost, atmosphere and staffs’ service mind of this clinic.

If you’re a foreigner, please by all cost avoid this place. I came in for a tooth cleaning and filling, I spoke to the receptionist and she told me the price, I’ve been told in Thailand to always confirm the price before any sales or procedures. It was the day of my appointment, I went into the doctor’s treatment room. His name is DR Padete, tall and slim man. I could tell from his demeanor that he doesn’t like Farangs, but I proceeded as I was in pain as I needed a tooth cleaning and filling. We sat down and he showed me my X-ray, he proceeded to telling me that I needed a root canal in which I didn’t need.  I told him, it’s not the first time I’ve ever been to the dentists, he continued to say I needed 4 visits in which I replied … the issue I have does not require 4 visits… I told him, I’m from the UK, when we go to the dentists, they will explain to you that we will clean your teeth then provide you with a filling that will last 6 months, you don’t need to come back. I believe this doctor tells patients this in order to extort them. So I explained to him, what I need doesn’t need 4 visits… so after many debates, he proceeded with the treatment. During the treatment, he gave me Anaesthesia, while waiting for it to kick him, I told him it hasn’t kicked in yet, I could still feel my teeth. He ignored me and said we needed to do the treatment now. Being on the table, I submitted to him saying he had to start now. As he started I could still feel pain when he drilled into my teeth, I told him to stop please. What then came out of his mouth really surprised me as him being a doctor he said “if you want me to stop the treatment, you can leave” whilst in the middle of him drilling my tooth, and I could feel pain, I then told him… sir I’m not a Dog, or even a Dog is treated better than this, is it because I’m black?! His two assistance then proceed to laugh at me being in pain.

He proceeded with the treatment while he administered another anaesthesia into my gum. Finally the treatment was done. I could feel how rough he was with my teeth and how badly he’s treated me. As I processed what just happened, I continued to get myself ready to go… he never said anything to me after as to what I needed to do next, no information as to please don’t eat, until a certain time. So I exited the surgery room and went to the reception in which the reception lady tried to extort me and say the procedure was 3000 when initially I opted for the 800-1000 treatment. I paid for the treatment after going back and forth as he saw that I was complaining to the English fella and his Thai girlfriend sitting waiting for their treatment. They saw and understood my concerns after explain everything to them despite still being under the influence of anaesthesia… the hole is still in my tooth as he didn’t fill it in. I came for that specific purpose but he didn’t do complete his task.

Please avoid this place at all cost if you’re a foreigner, especially if you’re BLACK.

Thank you for reading.
